primary_question: Does independent calibration of simulated cache pressure and repeated copy bytes improve prospective CPU time and limit predictions?
crossing: Fixed number of seeded gathers over three footprints, with two REP MOVSB byte counts per footprint. Pin corpus source, binaries, inputs and independently generated answers before native calibration.

models.control: Fit historical 15 only. Reproduce published six-counter coefficients.
models.expanded: Fit same 15 plus all six new calibration medians. Each case gets one relative-error residual. No stability-based exclusion.

estimator: Nonnegative least squares on residuals relative to each median, zero intercept, same six features and integer rounding at denominator 1000000000 as the published memory candidate. No model selection.
counts: Instructions, REP MOVS bytes, REP STOS bytes, raw recurrence, gshare14 misses and total simulated L1D misses. Join each diagnostic pass by binary/input/output and check all common ordinary counters per replay.
seal: Publish both fits and all three predictions per new external program before any native or live blind requests. Blind labels are excluded from fitting.
native: Three native-before, ordinary-live, native-after triplets per program. Native target is the median of the six uninstrumented CPU times.

gates.accuracy: Each of three predictions for every distinct blind program must be within 20% of its native median.
gates.minimum: Every native sample must be at least 20 ms.
gates.counter_stability: (max-min)/median <= 0.001 for every feature, with constant zero stable.

limits: Compare predicted AC/TLE to three actual native verdicts at each rounded 0.8x and 1.2x native median and expanded median. Reuse identical integer limits within a case. Measure ordinary live v8 at native-centered limits; retain mixed native verdicts explicitly.
ambiguity: On the original and expanded training medians, bound nonnegative six-counter predictions for historical Fenwick and new input counts subject to per-row +/-6% and +/-20% constraints. Report infeasibility when appropriate, with smallest possible worst relative training residual. No new weights selected from these bounds.
scope: C++20, x86-64, this workload and Cloud Run configuration. Production policy is outside this experiment.
